sn37.32:1.1: pañcimāni bhikkhave ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.4: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.6: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ. dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.7: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyanti
sn37.32:1.8: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.9: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti
sn37.32:1.10: idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.11: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṃ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti.
sn37.32:1.12: idaṃ bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:1.13: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.1: pañcimāni bhikkhave ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.4: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.6: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.7: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyanti.
sn37.32:2.8: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.9: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti.
sn37.32:2.10: idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.11: patirūpakule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṃ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti.
sn37.32:2.12: idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.13: imāni kho bhikkhave pañcaṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmenāti.
